films.title: Went the Day Well?
films.overview: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

films.title: Dead of Night
films.overview: An architect, visiting an English country house, realizes the other guests are familiar from his recurring nightmare. When they share their tales of the supernatural, he is filled with a growing dread.

films.title: They Made Me a Fugitive
films.overview: After being framed for a policeman's murder, a criminal escapes prison and sets out for revenge.
